signal: PerformYard expanded AI-assisted reviews and published its 2025 State of Performance Management report (managers with 20+ reports see goal completion drop to 60%)

email.body1:
Dalton, saw PerformYard rolled out AI-assisted reviews and published its State of Performance Management report.

Momentum like that opens more HR buyers as prospects than the team can personally cover before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for PerformYard off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dalton, quick follow-up for PerformYard.

A new AI capability usually expands the in-market list faster than headcount can keep up, and the coverage gap shows up late as a missed quarter. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PerformYard needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dalton, last bit of proof for PerformYard.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PerformYard's reply rate likely compares to other HR-tech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dalton, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Shipping AI-assisted reviews is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an HR-tech motion? I'll tailor it to PerformYard either way.
